messages.english: Enter nursery tray dimensions in centimetres or inches.
messages.translation: Kenya litekanyo tsa literei tsa sebaka sa lipeo ka lisenthimithara (cm) kapa ka li-inch (in).

messages.english: Enter usable nursery surface in square metres or square feet.
messages.translation: Kenya bokaholimo bo sebelisehang ba sebaka sa lipeo ka limithara tsa sekwere (m²) kapa ka maoto a sekwere (ft²).

messages.english: Keep nursery entries until their save is confirmed.
messages.translation: Tlohela lintlha tse kenyelitsoeng tsa sebaka sa lipeo li ntse li le teng ho fihlela ho bolokoa ha tsona ho netefatsoa.
Khetha li-unit tsa sebaka sa lipeo
Moralo oa tlhahiso → Moralo oa sebaka sa lipeo

messages.english: Choose your units, enter tray sizes and usable growing surface, then save. Unknown equipment values stay blank; zero stock stays zero.
messages.translation: Khetha li-unit tsa hau, kenya boholo ba literei le bokaholimo bo sebelisehang ba ho melisa, ebe oa boloka. Litekanyo tsa thepa tse sa tsejoeng li lula li se na letho; palo ea thepa ea lefeela e lula e le lefeela.
